definitions.explanation: rigorous training or practice to improve one's skills, character, or spiritual development

examples.japanese: {日々|ひび}{修練|しゅうれん}を{積|つ}む。
examples.english: To train diligently day after day.

examples.japanese: {厳|きび}しい{修練|しゅうれん}を{重|かさ}ねる。
{武道|ぶどう}の{修練|しゅうれん}で{心身|しんしん}を{鍛|きた}える。
examples.english: To train the mind and body through martial arts practice.

notes:
USAGE:
- {修練|しゅうれん}を{積|つ}む (to accumulate training)
- {修練|しゅうれん}を{重|かさ}ねる (to train repeatedly)
- {修練|しゅうれん}{期間|きかん} (training period)

NUANCE:
{修練|しゅうれん} emphasizes disciplined, often spiritual or character-building practice. More formal and traditional than {練習|れんしゅう}.

CONTEXTS:
- Martial arts
- Religious/spiritual practice
- Traditional arts (tea ceremony, calligraphy)
- Professional development

RELATED:
- {鍛錬|たんれん} (tempering, training - physical emphasis)
- {練習|れんしゅう} (practice - general)
- {修行|しゅぎょう} (ascetic training)
- {訓練|くんれん} (drill, training)
